title: Differential Cross Section
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive the expression for the differential cross section.

title: Total Cross Section
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive the expression for the total cross section.

title: Imaginary Part of Amplitude
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly apply the optical theorem to find the imaginary part of the forward scattering amplitude.

title: Fourier Transform Steps
description: Important Criteria: The student must show the correct steps in performing the Fourier transform of the Yukawa potential.

title: Variable Definitions
description: Important Criteria: The student must clearly define all variables used in the calculations, such as q and k.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the derivations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect factors in the final expressions.

title: Integration Limits
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure the correct limits are used during integration for the total cross section.
